title: feat(cli): os migrate stored-references reports the stored references the resolution rule refuses, and binds one reviewed row (ADR-0150 D10 S4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Qq5nLmmtyaegPyAGMQtoTu)_

Fixes #31693

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

1. 新增只读命令 `os migrate stored-references`：列出 S2/S3 回填后仍为 null、被 D3 规则拒绝的存储引用，每行带表、行 id 和全部候选（限定地址）。
2. 新增 `os migrate stored-references bind`：一次只绑一行，写入前重新问一遍 D3，过期报告、已绑定、非候选一律拒绝且写 0 行。
3. 环境独占（D3 (a)）和闭包外（D3 (c)）只报告、永不绑定；R10 派发键只报告。
4. 每次绑定经系统上下文写入，组合了审计插件，留下一行 `sys_audit_log`；第二次执行写 0 行。
5. 不改任何现有行为；解析从不放宽；无「全部绑定」。新增一条 ADR-0087 语义迁移条目。
6. 改动约 1240 行，低于 3000 行人工合并线；三组消融均变红并已复原。

## What changes

- `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts`: the D10 report and the reviewed bind over the D8 table list (R1, R3, R5, R6, R7, R8, R9, R10, R11, R13, R20). Every row is asked exactly what its S2/S3 backfill asked, through objectql `resolvePackageScopedName` (R3 from the row's `package_id`, every other row with no caller). No third traversal.
  - A finding is `{ d8, table, id, column, packageColumn, name, callerPackageId?, reason, candidates }`, where reason is `ambiguous`, `environment-only` (D3 (a)) or `outside-closure` (D3 (c)), and each candidate is spelled by its qualified address (`namespace/name`, `_env/name`).
  - R17: the packaged picklist fields the rule refuses, from `SchemaRegistry.findOutsideClosurePicklistReferences()`, the one reader that exists (the other R17 kinds get readers with their B children).
  - The sealed clashes `sealBareNameHolders()` answers on the report boot, each with both holders.
  - Every D8 table the composition does not carry is named (`tablesNotCarried`), never silently skipped.
- `os migrate stored-references` (read-only): boots as `os serve` composes (`--preset`, `--dev`), deferred and read-only. Migrate boots compose providers for their declarations only, so no S2/S3 backfill runs there (measured in step 0). `--json` carries no clock or duration, so two runs print the same bytes.
- `os migrate stored-references bind --table T --id ID --package P`: one row per run, `--yes` or `[y/N]`, the SQLite occupancy gate and `--force`.
  - The write happens only if the row's package column is still null, the row is one its column is kept for, and the rule asked again at write time still refuses the name as ambiguous and still names P among its candidates.
  - Otherwise it is refused with its reason and writes nothing: `already-bound`, `resolved`, `not-held`, `environment-only`, `outside-closure`, `not-a-candidate`, `report-only` (R10), `table-not-carried`, `no-such-row`, `not-asked`, `unknown-table`.
  - The write is `engine.update` under the system context on a boot composing `AuditPlugin`, so it leaves one `sys_audit_log` row.
- Rosters:
  - Both commands join the one-shot-family `CALLERS`.
  - The bind joins the migrate confirmation-exit `ROSTER`. Its discovery now walks a topic's subcommands, since this is the first one under `commands/migrate/`.
  - The report joins the json-stdout-purity family.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` rows, the ADR-0087 semantic entry `stored-reference-package-bind-reviewed`, and the changeset (patch on cli and spec).

## Why

ADR-0150 D10 (child S4 of #31527). Before this change, the S2/S3 backfills left an ambiguous stored reference null with one boot warning per name: no row id, no command, and no machine-readable form.

## Verification

- `stored-references.integration.test.ts`, 7/7 on SQLite through oclif, over a fabricated three-package database:
  - The report lists ambiguous R5 with candidates A and B, environment-only R3, an R17 outside-closure picklist field and a sealed picklist clash. It never lists the one-holder row.
  - Two report runs give byte-identical stdout and both tables are unchanged.
  - The bind writes B into exactly one row, plus one `sys_audit_log` row (`new_value {"package_id": B}`). The report then drops that row, and a second bind answers `already-bound` and writes 0.
  - Stale: B's rule is removed after the review, so the bind answers `resolved` and writes nothing.
  - Environment-only, not-a-candidate, report-only and unconfirmed binds write nothing.
  - CONTROL: a one-package database reports nothing and binds nothing.
- Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restored, blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty):
  1. The bind writes without consulting the write-time verdict: 3 red (stale, environment-only/not-a-candidate, CONTROL).
  2. The `environment-only` reason class is dropped: 3 red (report, bind-then-report, environment-only bind).
  3. The bind boot without `AuditPlugin`: the audit pin is red (`expected +0 to be 1`).
- `migrate-confirmation-exit.pin`, `schema-migrate.one-shot-family.integration` and the new file: 230/230. `json-stdout-purity.e2e` (nightly tier): 104/104.
- `pnpm lint` (root eslint over `packages/cli` and `packages/spec`): exit 0. CLI `tsc --noEmit`: exit 0. spec `src/migrations` tests: 198/198. `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide`: ok.
- Dispatch gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 117 derived, 117 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, all exit 0. Most ran at e8312f59; the two later commits only touch test files, `check:test-source-alias` was re-run at a39b4f5a, and the derived list is identical at HEAD. Eleven gates first answered exit 3 (no dist, shallow fixture commit) and were re-run green after a full `turbo run build`.

## Readings (ADR-0150, each child's releasability)

- **(a)** The phase-1 one-holder tests stay green: objectql `registry-bare-name-one-holder*`, `package-scoped-resolver` and `registry-namespace-co-owner-names`, 6 files, 287/287. No runtime package is touched.
- **(b)** Bare-name behaviour is unchanged for every name. The PR adds two CLI commands and changes no reader, door, URL, MCP or SDK path. The report only reads, and the bind writes only a column no reader uses yet.
- **(c)** The migration is re-runnable and never guesses. The report gives byte-identical output on a rerun. The bind writes only the operator's named package, only among the candidates the rule names at write time, one row per run; a second run writes 0 and a stale report binds nothing. There is no bind-all.
- **(d)** `Clause-②: no` (two new commands; nothing existing changes). `Metadata-protocol: none`, as the seat ruled on Q5. The ADR-0087 semantic entry `stored-reference-package-bind-reviewed` tells an upgrading operator to run the report. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` passes ("adds no declared-breaking changeset").

## Deviations and notes

- Only the bind has a write mode. In the one-shot-family pin, its write case runs against the shared fixture, which stores no sharing rule, so it reaches its plain boot and refuses `no-such-row`. The written row is pinned in the dedicated integration file.
- A declined `[y/N]` keeps exit 0, as its siblings (`packageless-overlays`, `recorded-by`) do. A non-interactive run without `--yes` exits 1.
- The bind spreads the report's flags, so json-stdout-purity's text discovery (`json: Flags.boolean(`) does not reach it. Its whole-stdout `JSON.parse` is pinned in the integration file.
- The automation and approvals tables (R7 to R11) are read only when the host config composes their plugins. Otherwise the report names them under `tablesNotCarried`.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. The registry is generated and gitignored; `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` pass.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
